name: Lime & Coconut Panna Cotta — Caramelized Pineapple & Toasted Coconut
alt: Lime and coconut panna cotta with caramelized pineapple and toasted coconut: a white set panna cotta on a matte black plate, crowned with caramelized pineapple and toasted coconut shavings, finished with lime zest, a single mint leaf and two dots of red fruit coulis.
